test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) in the following series to continue the pattern?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa7b3adef5cef1c2e7c295dc30c02c17df536aa17fd497c8e2a32bf8da2e1626.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The bottom elements, center element and the top right corner elements shift anticlockwise.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise in the downward direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d36bb8c2b21737b4d14c832e42bd4a22dc2c4cd5b665625d44e2a2674ae5b76e.png] 

2) Second box series → 

The elements at the corner shift clockwise.

No change in the center element.

The rest of the elements interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08cd71161ea40e4a3268cc254b13ab43f916c2ed175b82a358c56cb3c70fb1b6.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/015da5d6fde5eb3639dccb61bebece274b1022736d303c1b7f5968fd0b176d3d.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
